_comment: REAL US DTC wellness ads harvested from the Meta Ad Library on 2026-07-31 via browser, annotated by hand. `excluded:true` ads demonstrate the Brand Quality Filter (spec 1) — astrology, THC/kratom, and dramatized clickbait are stripped before sampling. snapshot: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=<libraryId>

ads.hook: A family medicine PA sent the most popular creatine gummies to an independent lab and ranked them best to worst.
ads.angle: Insider expert exposes the category, then ranks it

ads.body: A family medicine PA just did something most brands were hoping nobody would. She sent the most popular creatine gummies to an independent lab and ranked them from best to worst. Nearly half barely had any real creatine. It's third-party tested, made in the USA. Her number one pick is on sale, and it keeps selling out.
